column1: # ICIMD enum-value -> canonical ICIMD nosology prefix crosswalk.
# Maps each `icimd_category` permissible value used in kb/ to the ICIMD
# nosology-number prefix (category.group) of the ICIMD node it encodes,
# transcribed from the ICIMD classification (Ferreira et al. 2021,
# PMID:33340416) and reconciled against the authoritative IEMbase browse
# to detect drift: an entry whose causative gene sits in a different ICIMD
# category than its assigned value is flagged. Multiple prefixes (| separated)
# mean the dismech value deliberately collapses >1 adjacent ICIMD subgroup.
# This is a hand-verified reference artifact, NOT auto-generated at check
# time. Only the freely-citable ICIMD classification codes are stored here;
# no IEMbase database content is redistributed.
